prompt_semantic_leakage_validation.scope: Raw evidence and content hashes do not establish whether earlier arguments reveal final votes

B_minus_H.sensitivity_scope: Observed complete pairs only, excluding prefixes/meetings with no complete pair; treatment-dependent failures can bias this estimate

sharp_missing_outcome_bounds.scope: All planned pairs; feasible Governor actions conditional on retained peers, global bounds for unobserved prefixes; logical bounds, not sampling uncertainty

uncertainty.assumptions: Independent Governor draws conditional on retained prefixes for the first SE; independent exchangeable generated prefixes within each fixed meeting for the second SE; neither assumption is established by artifact hashes
uncertainty.scope: Fixed cohort simulation Monte Carlo only; undefined for missing outcomes or insufficient replicates. Few prefixes give unreliable variance estimates; more draws do not add independent meetings.

B_minus_H.verification_scope: Retained prefix/branch/transcript bytes, hashes, canonical request identities, raw/parsed ballot joins and prompt-byte consistency; provider authentication, source eligibility and billing are separate audits
B_minus_H.weighting: equal meetings; equal prefixes within meeting; planned draws averaged within prefix
